description: TROPES ARE THE ADMISSIBILITY GRAMMAR OF NARRATIVE, one level up from narrative_structure's story-grammar arc (which is itself one level up from discourse_coherence's span-pair relations, itself one level up from reading_collapse's clause constructions). Where narrative_structure decodes WHICH ROLE one event plays in a goal-pursuit chain, this codebook decodes WHICH RECURRING NARRATIVE PATTERN the WHOLE ARC instantiates -- a trope. Every arc narrative_structure.recognize_narrative_structure already built is turned into a SMALL SET of mechanical, already-committed-fact tokens (does the arc carry a 'problem' role? a 'resolution' role? does its 'solution' role's own outgoing causal edge trace to a PHYSICAL-EFFECT displacement schema -- inference_generation.resolve_causal_gap's own decode, evidence of an INDIRECT mechanism rather than direct force? does the solution sentence's own situation-model ingest record carry a PLURAL affected entity -- evidence of an INCREMENTAL, repeated small action rather than one blow? did a PRECONDITION/BLOCKING gap have to be resolved for this entity before its chain could complete -- inference_generation.resolve_precondition_gap's own decode, evidence the direct path was BLOCKED?) and that token SET is decoded against this codebook by the SAME ShapeDecode set-cover search reading_collapse/discourse_coherence/narrative_structure already use -- the TROPE NAME is always the winning ShapeSignatureTrope's own `name` attr (read off the decode's own `plan`, one entry per recognised trope -- MULTIPLE tropes can be recognised for one arc when the decode's own set-cover finds a multi-step plan), never a Python if/else naming a trope. `label_candidates` supplies a short list of TV Tropes search phrases (domains/tropes_teacher.py's own corpus lookup, used ONLY to attach a citable name/definition to an already-decided trope -- never to decide which trope fired); `theme` is this module's own held one-line moral, read off verbatim by the caller, never re-derived from free text.

microtheory.name: narrative_tropes
microtheory.description: The recurring narrative-construction pattern ('tropes are the admissibility grammar of narrative') a story's already-recognised arc instantiates, decoded by ShapeDecode set-cover against a dedicated ShapeSignatureTrope codebook -- one level up from the story-grammar arc.

attrs.name: INGENUITY_OVER_STRENGTH
attrs.theme: Ingenuity overcomes an obstacle that force could not -- cleverness over strength.
attrs.note: The arc carries a 'problem' role (an obstacle, discourse_coherence's own decoded 'contrast' into the goal-pursuit chain) AND its 'solution' role's own outgoing causal edge was minted via a PHYSICAL-EFFECT displacement schema (inference_generation.resolve_causal_gap's own decode, e.g. drop-a-solid -> a-level-rises) rather than any direct force applied to the obstacle itself -- the goal-holder solved the problem INDIRECTLY, through a physical mechanism, not brute strength.

attrs.name: PERSISTENCE_PAYS
attrs.theme: Small repeated efforts accumulate into success -- little by little, persistence pays.
attrs.note: The arc's 'solution' role's own situation-model ingest record (situation_model_reader/coref_entities' own already-committed predication) carries a PLURAL affected entity (coref_number=='plural' -- many small units acted on one at a time, not one single blow) AND the arc reaches a 'resolution' role (a causal-chain effect sentence whose own recognised words include the goal's remedy token) -- the goal was met by REPEATED small increments, not one decisive act.

attrs.name: NECESSITY_INVENTION
attrs.theme: Necessity is the mother of invention -- a blocked direct path forces a novel workaround.
attrs.note: A PRECONDITION/BLOCKING gap (inference_generation.detect_precondition_gaps/resolve_precondition_gap's own decode -- a stalled world-knowledge rule one conjunct away from firing) was resolved for this entity, AND the solution's own causal edge traces to a physical-effect schema (the same TROPE_INDIRECT signal INGENUITY_OVER_STRENGTH reads) -- the direct route was genuinely BLOCKED, forcing the indirect one, distinct from a story that simply preferred cleverness with no blocked precondition on record.
